info.title: KV Silver Zone API
info.description: API documentation for KV Silver Zone. Auth is via an httpOnly cookie set on /auth/login (a Bearer token is also returned for API clients). Protected endpoints accept either.

message.example: price must be a positive number

imageBase64.description: Base64 data URL or image URL

ProductPricing.description: Live pricing breakdown computed server-side from the silver rate.

material.description: Free-text spec (e.g. metal/purity blend); not the taxonomy category

subcategory.description: Only set for categories with children (currently Jewellery)

isFixedPrice.description: Flat price; no dynamic metal-rate calc

subcategory.description: Must be a registered child of category

tags.description: Optional; a comma-separated string is also accepted. Full replacement on update.

weight.description: Grams. Required unless isFixedPrice is true.

image.description: Primary image (= images[0]); kept for backward compatibility

images.description: Ordered gallery; images[0] is the primary image. Each entry is a base64 data URL (new upload) or an existing image reference echoed from a GET. Full replacement on update; empty array clears all images.

variants.description: Full replacement array on update; empty array clears all variants

type.description: percentage = percent (0-100); amount = flat rupee amount

token.description: JWT (also set as an httpOnly cookie)

put.description: Staff cannot call this — passbook records can only be modified by a full admin. The passbook number itself is never editable (it's the tracking key already handed out to the customer); only planName/monthlyAmount/duration/bonusAmount/totalPaid/ status/startDate can be corrected.

post.summary: Create a Razorpay order for this scheme's next monthly installment
post.description: The amount is always the scheme's own `monthlyAmount` — server-computed, never client input. Step 1 of the customer self-pay flow; step 2 is `/pay/verify`.

post.summary: Verify a Razorpay installment payment and record it on the ledger
post.description: Verifies the payment signature, re-confirms the amount Razorpay actually captured matches the scheme's monthly amount, converts the collection to silver grams at the live rate, and mints the passbook if this was the scheme's first payment.
